transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess I'm here because... well, it's about my house. The foreclosure. Everyone keeps acting like it's just normal paperwork and missed payments. But... I know that's not what's happening. 

The bank, the loan servicer... even people at my job. They've been quietly working together to push me out. They keep showing me all these papers to prove it's just a normal foreclosure, but... it doesn't change what I've been seeing for almost two years now. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you believe that these people are working against you in ways that others wouldn't be able to see, or that there's some hidden plan you've uncovered that others don't seem to notice?

Yeah... I mean, like I just said. Other people just look at the papers and think it's a normal foreclosure. They don't see it. 

But... yes. I know they're working together. I've been watching it happen for two years now. No matter what paperwork they try to show me, it doesn't change the fact that they have a plan to push me out.
Have you noticed any other situations, outside of the foreclosure, where you feel people are working against you or involved in some hidden plan?

No... not really. If it doesn't have to do with the house, things are fine. 

I still get up every day and go to work. I supervise my team, handle the schedules and the customers... I take care of myself. It's really just... it mostly starts when I get certain mail, or the bank calls. Or if there's paperwork at my job that ties back to the house. That's when I notice it. Otherwise, I just do my job.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others don’t seem to share or understand, even when there’s no connection to your house or foreclosure?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I already told you, it's just the house. I don't... I don't really know what else you're looking for.
Have you ever believed something to be true that others insist isn’t real, even when there wasn’t any connection to your house or foreclosure?
I just... I just said no. I don't know why you keep asking the same thing. It's just the house. That's it.
Have you ever had a strong belief about something that turned out not to be true, even after others showed you proof or evidence to the contrary?
No. I haven't. I... I really don't know what kind of answer you're waiting for. I'm not making things up, if that's what you're getting at. I told you what's happening, and... that's it.
Have you ever had any beliefs that most people would find strange or impossible, even if they weren’t related to your house or work?
No. I... I really don't. I don't understand why we keep going in circles with this. I don't have strange beliefs. I just... I don't have anything else to tell you about that.
Have you ever had a belief that something was definitely true, even when there was clear evidence it wasn't, and no connection to your house or foreclosure?
I... no. I haven't. I really don't have anything else to say about this. You just keep asking the same question over and over. I don't know what you want me to say.
Have you ever felt, in any part of your life outside of the foreclosure, that things are being controlled or manipulated in a way that others don’t seem to notice?
No. I... I don't feel that way. I just... I go to work, I do my job at the store, I come home. That's it. I don't know why you're asking me all these things.
